intent: Repair the observed phone task-context failure diagnostics and bounded recovery, and surface integration fixture prerequisites before acquisition while preserving exact approval and receipt-based acceptance.
authority: Existing task source, approval, identity, privacy, tool-call and deadline limits remain unchanged. Independent source reads require their normal authorization. No remote publication is owned by this lane.

findings.scope: Phone task-context typed failures and safe application frames; independent authorized source reads; explicit per-blob deferred outcomes and no-progress limits. Separately, phone index outer deadlines now persist the active blob attempt, retain first-attempt deferred reasons, and reach later files after the existing two-attempt limit without claiming complete coverage.

The first integration checkpoint explains the retained exact fixture approval and real run/job prerequisites before the next tool call. Acceptance keeps exact-SHA test receipts, pending continuation validity and discovery reserve as separate evidence components; no saved page or catalog receipt counts as test execution.
